chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In the database management system, today's topic is EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We will cover in this video what EER Model is

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We will understand it practically in full explanation

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In the last video, we covered EER Model and Data Abstraction in EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If you haven't seen that video, please watch it

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Because in this video, we will cover the concept of that video in advance

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: EER Model is an extension of the EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: EER Model stands for Enhance or Extension Entity Relationship Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have the EER Model in the Enhance version

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It is an extension of EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In comparison to EER Model, this EER Model makes complex real-world relationship more easy due to its additional concepts

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We used EER Model to design a design on the University Management System

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Which was very complex

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We will now do the same design through EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: You will see that we will be able to design the same complex design very easily

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Because after this, there are many additional concepts

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Like Generalization, Specialization, Aggregation, Union, Subclass, Superclass

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We can do this with the help of 5 concepts

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We can easily design a complex design through EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: You should know some features of EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: So that you can easily design

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: The first feature is that EER creates a design more accurate to the database scheme

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Whatever the scheme of our database is, we can create design through EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: According to the database scheme

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It includes all the modeling features of EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: All the features of EER Model are included in EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: EER Model is widely used to design complex databases in large applications

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If you are creating a large application

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: And you have created a database scheme

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: And you can easily design the same to same of that database scheme

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Look at the example

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We will design our own design on the University Management System

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Our design will be done through the EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have also done the same design through the EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In the video, I will give the link in the description

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: You can see it first

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Then you will understand how EER is easy through EER

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In the University Management System

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If we talk about a university, what will be there?

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: There will be a person who works

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: So the person becomes the General Entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If we specialize this person, then there will be some student and teacher

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: The same person

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: This is the specialization of the person

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: There will be many departments in the university

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: They will aggregate courses and teachers

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: There will be many teachers in the department and many courses to be taught

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Let's design the EER Model of this University Management System

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Here is the design of the EER Model of the University Management System

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have department, teacher, courses

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: After that there is a person

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: And after specializing the person, a different student is created here

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If we start from here

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have a different department of the person

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: MCA, BCI student

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: So this person is created

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: After that, the course is completed

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Then the teacher is done here

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: And here is the department

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Now let's understand this

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In one department, there is only one HOD and head

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: And in one department, there are many teachers

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Now here, a teacher can teach many courses

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: And many courses can be enrolled by many people

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: And many people can be of different departments

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: So see how easily we created the design

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Through the EER Model of the University Management System

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Now we have the design of the EER Model and our topic

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: What can we do next?

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Now we can easily design the scheme of our database

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Through the same model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have seen the design

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Because we have understood all the requirements here

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: So this is our simple EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In the last video, we implemented the same design through the EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: There were many complexities in making the same design

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: To avoid the same complexity, we developed the EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In which specialization, aggregation and generalization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: As the concept was added

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: With the help of which we can easily create complex design

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: So let's hope you have understood the EER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If you have come, then like the video

chunks.title: lecture
